text:
support_olivia: FYI acme-inc on prod-us-east reporting p99 generation latency jumped to ~8-12s starting ~20:00 UTC. Multiple requests failing SLAs, customer very noisy.
eng_oncall_mike: looking now, I'm seeing an admit queue growth on runtime workers, large tail latencies for short requests.
sre_ana: metrics snapshot: admit_queue=134 for tenant=acme-inc, inflight=52, concurrency_limit=40, worker_pods=12. p95 before 18:30 ~1.1s -> now 3.6s, p99 4.9s -> 9.7s.
runtime_lead_karthik: did we roll any batching or kernel changes around 18:45?
support_olivia: attaching customer's quick repro (they used curl).
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"short prompt"}'
```
deploy-bot: Rollout completed: batching-params v2.3 -> v2.4 at 18:46 UTC (deploy-id: deploy-7890) :deploy: 
eng_oncall_mike: that matches the timeline. v2.4 increased default max_batch_size 32->64 and bumped batch-wait heuristics. If autoscaler or worker count is low, larger batches can increase queueing for latency-sensitive tenants.
sre_ana: logs excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-15T20:02:11Z] worker-pool/worker-7 admit_queue=134 inflight=52 concurrency_limit=40
[2026-03-15T20:02:12Z] runtime admission: enqueued request tenant=acme-inc seq=0 model=redwood-1
[2026-03-15T20:02:13Z] batch-assembled size=58 wait_ms=1200
```
runtime_lead_karthik: proposed mitigations (short):
- rollback batching-params to v2.3 in prod-us-east (immediate)
- scale worker-pool replicas from 12 -> 20 (temp)
- set per-tenant override: acme-inc max_batch_size=16, prefer low-latency path
- enable overflow routing to dedicated low-latency pool for critical tenants
support_olivia: acme-inc agreed to fallback to low-latency model variant while we fix.
eng_oncall_mike: executing hotfixes now: 
`kubectl set image deployment/worker-pool worker=worker:hotfix-2026 && kubectl scale deployment/worker-pool --replicas=20`
devops_jamie: started canary rollback of batching-params to v2.3 (canary id canary-102) across 2 pods first.
sre_ana: realtime: admit_queue dropping -> 12, inflight -> 22, p95 trending down to ~1.2s after canary and scale. p99 trending 1.8s and decreasing.
runtime_lead_karthik: also applying an admission-control tweak: soft_concurrency=40, hard_limit=60, enable overflow to dedicated-latency pool for tenants flagged as critical. Will add a per-tenant max_batch override config.
support_olivia: customer reports p95 ~1.1s now, very relieved. They've accepted temporary fallback until full rollback is confirmed.
eng_oncall_mike: follow-ups: add canary safety for batching config changes, add per-tenant batch caps, tune autoscaler to react to admit_queue length, and create incident ticket INC-3456 for postmortem and action items.
support_olivia: thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Completed rollback rollout to v2.3 in prod-us-east (deploy-7890 -> reverted)
devops_jamie: will open PR for per-tenant overrides and add a dashboard alert on admit_queue > 50 for 2m.
sre_ana: logging note: capture batch assembly wait_ms in more granularity (histograms) so we can alert before p99 jumps.
support_olivia: closing loop with acme-inc, will send summary after postmortem.
eng_oncall_mike: marking thread for incident INC-3456, adding owners: runtime-team, autoscale, support.
support_olivia: nice work team.
